title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1201 Sycamore Square Drive in Midlothian, Virginia, as the Dorothy Braden Bruce Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1201 Sycamore Square Drive in Midlothian, Virginia, as the "Dorothy Braden Bruce Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Postal Service building in Midlothian, Virginia, after Dorothy Braden Bruce.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1201 Sycamore Square Drive in Midlothian, Virginia, as the Dorothy Braden Bruce Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 17, 2020, and the name change applies from that date.
